notes.title: 11/17/23 Tutorial fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a few specific situations in which you could get stuck in the tutorial
 Fixed the log files not showing up when reporting a bug
 Removed the introductory text

notes.title: 16/11/23 Update
notes.content: When reporting a bug, a file explorer window opens at the log files location, which can then be uploaded on the form.

notes.title: 14/11/23 - New Features
notes.content:
Flags are no longer neatly ordered. You have to search for the proper flag.
 Enemy Towers have been introduced, they will attack unless you equip their flag.
 Enemies now have a delay before they start attacking you, allowing the cartographer to change flag, to start attacking or running.
 A second fishing mini-game has been introduced, the game will be picked at random when you enter a fishing spot. 
 Contextual help now stays visible until the player hides it with 'T'.


Because of these new features, the occasional bug may pop up, be sure to report it!
Fixed bug where flag drawer would push player outside of the cabin

notes.title: 29/10/2023 - New Features
notes.content:
You can now select which features are active in the game while in the lobby 
 Two new features : flags, and balance mini-game

notes.title: 27/10/2023 Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed some button hit boxes slightly offset
 Added an in game console that will pop up if an error is detected (can easily be closed with the mouse). It will make debugging easier.
 Fixed an edge case in whch the cartographer could be stuck in the cabin after a mermaid attack

notes.title: 26/10/2023 Hotfix
notes.content:

 Cartographer could get stuck in cabin

 When restarting a game, players could get stuck on map screens
